men.summary: Two games into the 2026-27 season, the Bluejays are 2-0 with wins over Kansas City (76-61) and Le Moyne (83-55), both at home, though they have yet to play a road, neutral-site, or Quadrant 1 game. With a NET ranking of 83, an RPI of 71, and Big East play still ahead, their postseason outlook is wide open and will depend on picking up quality wins in conference play to build an at-large case.

women.summary: Just one game into the 2026-27 season, the Bluejays sit at 1-0 after a 73-71 road win at South Dakota State that already counts as a Quadrant 1 victory, though their NET ranking of 91 and RPI of 147 reflect how little data exists so far. With Big East play still ahead at 0-0, it's too early to project a postseason path, but that opening road win gives them an early résumé boost as they chase an at-large bid.
